prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look. "Chrome-Boulevard", the luxury boulevard of the upper city, built on a gleaming platform high above the clouds. This is the rich upper city, NOT the slums: bright clean daylight, white marble and polished chrome with gold trim, glass, manicured plastic hedges, soft golden sunlight and pale blue sky reflections, only small touches of cyan and pink neon in shop signs. A very wide boulevard of white and cream marble slabs with thin gold inlay lines fills the middle of the image from the left edge to the right edge - this is the large walkable area, polished and reflective, uncluttered.
TOP ROW, a row of white towers with golden edges whose front facades face us:
TOP LEFT: a luxury boutique with tall shop windows framed in gold, mannequins with silk scarves in blue, red and green behind the glass, a velvet awning and a glass door.
TOP CENTER-LEFT: the penthouse house of a rich family - the most eye-catching spot: a tall white tower facade with a grand golden double entrance door under a canopy, a red carpet, and above it three big round balconies, one painted royal blue, one crimson red, one emerald green, each with plants and a parasol. Right next to the entrance a small elegant glass doorman's booth with a brass lamp and a little desk.
TOP CENTER-RIGHT: a jeweller's shop with a huge glowing holographic diamond floating above its entrance (cyan-white light), a vault-like brass door and display windows with necklaces on velvet.
Between the jeweller and the next tower: a narrow shady service alley going up to a dead end with a gold-rimmed trash bin and a small back door of the jeweller.
TOP RIGHT: the base of a very tall chrome skyscraper with a big ornate brass elevator door; next to the door a large brass ear sculpture mounted on the wall like an intercom.
TOP RIGHT CORNER: a clean white road leads up and out of the image through a gold-rimmed boom barrier toward a distant campus.
LEFT EDGE, middle: the top station of a glass panoramic elevator tube with golden frame, its glass doors facing right.
BOTTOM LEFT: a golden escalator going down into an underground metro station, with a gold railing and a round metro emblem (no letters).
CENTER-LEFT: a small square of perfect bright green artificial lawn with a golden dog water fountain, and a slim pole mast with a docked advertising drone on top.
CENTER: open marble, with a round golden mosaic inlay in the floor.
BOTTOM CENTER: an ornate white marble fountain with gold rim, and next to it a curved white bench facing the cloud edge.
BOTTOM RIGHT: an elegant café terrace with small round white tables, gold chairs and cream parasols on a slightly raised wooden deck.
BOTTOM EDGE: the platform ends at a continuous glass balustrade with a golden handrail; beyond it a soft sea of white clouds, and far, far below through gaps in the clouds tiny glimpses of a dark neon slum city.
Small stuff at the edges: potted topiary trees, golden street lamps, small golden drones, planters with white flowers, a red carpet runner. Nothing on the walkable marble in the middle.
EXITS clearly readable at the image edges: LEFT edge - the glass panoramic elevator; TOP RIGHT corner - the road with the boom barrier going north; the penthouse entrance door and the skyscraper elevator door on the top row; BOTTOM LEFT - the golden metro escalator.
Time: bright sunny afternoon above the clouds, warm golden light, soft shadows.
